expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Sleeping in Kyoto, not visiting it on a day trip, is what people remember. The lanes after dark are a different city.
expert.tip: Walk from the Shijo hotel to Gion at dusk, about fifteen minutes. The last night in Osaka keeps the airport train short.

summary: Seven days through three cities: Shinjuku with a city tour and Mount Fuji, two nights in Kyoto with a guided day to Nara, then a final night in Osaka near Namba before you fly home.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; bullet train from Tokyo to Kyoto and the train on to Osaka; private airport transfers; full day Tokyo city tour with lunch; Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip; a guided day through Kyoto and Nara with buffet lunch.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
